info.description: One published day's newspaper. The source PDF is uploaded here; pages/stories are generated from it by the ingest service.

pageCount.description: Filled in automatically once the PDF is processed

sourcePdf.description: The original print-ready PDF for this edition. Uploading/replacing this re-triggers the ingest pipeline.

pipelineStatus.description: pending: no PDF yet. processing: ingest service is rasterizing/extracting. ready_for_review: pages + draft story hotspots created, needs an editor to review before going live. published: reviewed and live. failed: see pipelineError.

archivePriceOverride.description: Optional per-edition override of the default archive unlock price

publicationCode.description: Constant per paper (e.g. 'NV' for New Vision) — a fixed default is all this needs while there's only one publication on this platform. Exists now so adding a second paper later doesn't require another schema migration; the SKU below is what actually needs it to stay unambiguous.

sku.description: Auto-generated on create, never entered by hand — see content-types/edition/lifecycles.js. Format: YYYYMMDD-PUBLICATIONCODE-ISSUENUMBER-RANDOM4. This is what Entitlement/Transaction records should reference for an unambiguous 'exactly this edition' link — `date` alone stops being unique the moment a second publicationCode exists on this platform.
